headline: A fan-art trend that redraws Harry Potter's Draco Malfoy as an anime girl has passed 21 million views, and one of its spin-off music videos was made with AI tools.
score_reason: Fan-culture trend with only a minor AI link and an article dated 12 Oct; lowered from 2.
importance_line: It shows a fan meme spreading widely with a name some find offensive, and AI appears only in one music video; it has little news weight.
summary: Fandom Pulse reports that 'Malfoid', fan art redrawing Draco Malfoy as an anime girl, began on 22 Sep 2026 and one X post had reached 21.9 million views by 12 Oct. Most of the work is drawn by hand, and the article says only one spin-off, a music video by Shad M. Brooks, was made with the AI tools Suno and Grok Imagine.
notes: Just Jared page blocked; read Fandom Pulse on the same trend. Pool headline's AI emphasis is wider than the article supports.
